_readme: Remote control for the MS Viewer extension. Edit the copy on the `updates` branch (ms-viewer/control.json) — installs re-read it every 15 min and before each load. Keys: enabled (global), message, notice (shown while enabled), minVersion, users{alias:{enabled,message}}, installs{installId:{enabled,message}}. A per-user/install enabled:true overrides a global enabled:false.
